description: Resolve a verification request for the selected Proofable checks. Returns current qualifying proofs when they exist; otherwise returns the single next step. This tool does not create a proof.

chain.description: Optional network hint. Omit when Proofable can infer it from the wallet format.

data.description: Inputs for the selected verifiers. Used only when a new Proof is needed.

requireAll.description: Require all listed verifiers. Default false accepts any one.

walletAddress.description: Wallet or DID. Omit when signed in to use the current account.

name: proofable_verify_or_guide
title: Verify or get next step
